blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validatePaymentProviderInRegionStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that a payment provider can be used for a payment collection.
If the payment collection belongs to an active (not yet completed) cart, the payment
provider must be enabled in the cart's region. If not, the step throws an error.

Payment collections that aren't linked to an active cart, such as those of an order,
aren't affected by this validation.

children.name: payment_collection_id
children.description: The ID of the payment collection that the payment session is created for.

children.name: provider_id
children.description: The ID of the payment provider to validate.
